title: New shared Scripts page and Studio sync reliability
changes: A full-width Shared Scripts page with search, filters, script cards and source preview
Edit script properties and publish only changed Luau source with revision safety
Stable script file paths and protection against overwriting local drafts
Workspace owners can remove invited members; editors and viewers can revoke their own access
Studio sync retries back off after failures and show diagnostics
Studio bridge detects local changes and cleans up failed managed script creation
